# montecarlo_looker_git_clone_credentials (Data Source)

LookML repository credentials are an HTTPS token or an SSH key Monte Carlo stores to clone the repository behind a Looker instance. The token or key is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `repo_url` (String) Clone URL of the LookML repository, over HTTPS or SSH.
- `ssl_ca_data` (String) PEM certificate of the CA that signed the git server's certificate. Null unless set.
- `ssl_skip_cert_verification` (Boolean) Skip verifying the git server's TLS certificate. Null unless set.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `username` (String) Git user. Null for an SSH clone.
